podcast.title: Johnny Marr's Brief Membership
podcast.body: The Smiths guitarist, Johnny Marr, was a member of The Cribs for three years, joining because he was a fan of the group. "With the exception of the time Johnny Mar, yes the Smiths guitarist, was part of the band. He stuck around for three years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: UK and European Success
podcast.body: The Cribs achieved substantial stardom within the UK and Europe, selling numerous records and earning many awards, even though they did not manage to become big outside of these regions. "The cribs never managed to make it big outside the UK and Europe, but they were substantial stars at home, selling plenty of records and winning a whack of awards."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Alex Kapranos's Activities During Band Break
xref.body: During the band's break after touring in late 2006, Alex Kapranos went to Vancouver to produce The Cribs' album and recorded his own album with a friend named Danny, released by Domino Records under the character name Victoria and Albert. The band regrouped in February 2007. "I went to Vancouver and produced the crib's last record. They went to New York and mixed that. I recorded an album, I hear my friend Danny, that's a character, which Domino put out this year actually."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
